title: Reverse Integer
description:
Given a signed 32-bit integer x, return x with its digits reversed. If reversing x causes the value to go outside the signed 32-bit integer range [-231, 231 - 1], then return 0.
Assume the environment does not allow you to store 64-bit integers (signed or unsigned).
 
Example 1:

Input: x = 123
Output: 321

Example 2:

Input: x = -123
Output: -321

Example 3:

Input: x = 120
Output: 21

 
Constraints:

-231 <= x <= 231 - 1

def check(candidate):
    assert candidate(x = 123) == 321
    assert candidate(x = -123) == -321
    assert candidate(x = 120) == 21
    assert candidate(x = -120) == -21
    assert candidate(x = 0) == 0
    assert candidate(x = 1534236469) == 0
    assert candidate(x = -2147483648) == 0
    assert candidate(x = 1463847412) == 2147483641
    assert candidate(x = -1463847412) == -2147483641
    assert candidate(x = 1000000003) == 0
